stem.en: In an osmosis test, some potato cups get sugar or salt, and one raw cup is kept empty. What is the use of the empty cup?

text.en: It gives a result to compare with the other cups.

feedback.en: Yes. It shows what happens with no sugar or salt.

text.en: It stores spare water for the other cups to use.

feedback.en: Each cup stands in its own beaker of water.

text.en: It shows what boiling does to a potato.

feedback.en: It is a raw cup, so it cannot show this.

text.en: It makes sure that the water in all the beakers stays warm.

feedback.en: An empty potato cup does not heat the water.

explanation.en: Without the empty cup, we could not tell whether the sugar or salt made the difference. A comparison like this is part of a fair experiment.

hints.en: If every cup had sugar or salt, what could you not tell?
